tasks.subject: Task 0: Repository scaffolding and test harness
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A runnable, green test harness plus a syntax probe proving every Foundry Script feature this plan depends on works before anything is built on it.

**Files:**
- Create: .gitignore, Taskfile.yml, .pre-commit-config.yaml, addons/FoundryKit/plugin.cfg, test_project/packages.toml, test_project/project.foundry, test_project/icon.svg, scripts/test-foundrylib
- Test: test_project/tests/syntax-probe.test.fs

**Verify:** task test:foundrylib -> exits 0, 7 passing tests in SyntaxProbeTests

**CRITICAL:** If a probe test fails to COMPILE, stop — the core design depends on that feature and must be revised before Task 1.

```json:metadata
{"files": [".gitignore", "Taskfile.yml", ".pre-commit-config.yaml", "addons/FoundryKit/plugin.cfg", "test_project/packages.toml", "test_project/project.foundry", "test_project/icon.svg", "scripts/test-foundrylib", "test_project/tests/syntax-probe.test.fs"], "verifyCommand": "task test:foundrylib", "acceptanceCriteria": ["task test:foundrylib exits 0", "syntax probe covers all depended-on language features", "installed packages gitignored"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Async signal bridge
tasks.description:
**Goal:** NativeRequest — converts a signal-based native call into an async function returning NativeOutcome, with a watchdog timeout.

**Files:**
- Create: addons/FoundryKit/core/NativeRequest.fs, test_project/tests/support/fake_native.notest.fs
- Test: test_project/tests/native-request.test.fs

**Verify:** task test:foundrylib -> 7 tests in NativeRequestTests pass

**If the timeout test hangs:** the headless runner has no SceneTree main loop — gate timeout tests behind a SceneTree null check rather than deleting them.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["addons/FoundryKit/core/NativeRequest.fs", "test_project/tests/support/fake_native.notest.fs", "test_project/tests/native-request.test.fs"], "verifyCommand": "task test:foundrylib", "acceptanceCriteria": ["success zips named payload", "failure reads code and message", "timeout resolves TimedOut", "settles once", "connections released", "missing fields omitted"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Request guard
tasks.description:

- Test: test_project/tests/request-guard.test.fs

**Verify:** task test:foundrylib -> 9 tests in RequestGuardTests pass

**If inline lambda syntax is unavailable:** replace the two lambda signal connections in the test with a counter method on the test class.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["addons/FoundryKit/core/RequestGuard.fs", "test_project/tests/request-guard.test.fs"], "verifyCommand": "task test:foundrylib", "acceptanceCriteria": ["single-flight enforced", "end releases gate", "backgrounding tracked", "recovery_due after grace", "no emission without active request"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: Backend factory trait
tasks.description:
**Goal:** BackendFactory[TBackend] — the generic trait replacing three copies of an OS-name match chain.

**Files:**
- Create: addons/FoundryKit/core/BackendFactory.fs, test_project/tests/support/fake_backends.notest.fs
- Test: test_project/tests/backend-factory.test.fs

**Verify:** task test:foundrylib -> 7 tests in BackendFactoryTests pass

**Two fallbacks:** (a) if one .fs file cannot declare multiple class_name types, split fake_backends into one type per file in the same namespace; (b) if a trait cannot carry concrete method bodies alongside abstract requirements, move resolve/resolve_current into a BackendResolver static helper taking the factory as a parameter.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["addons/FoundryKit/core/BackendFactory.fs", "test_project/tests/support/fake_backends.notest.fs", "test_project/tests/backend-factory.test.fs"], "verifyCommand": "task test:foundrylib", "acceptanceCriteria": ["generic trait satisfiable", "platform backend resolved", "null fallback on null", "UNKNOWN resolves null"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 9: Boundary enforcement and CI
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Make the architectural rules mechanical — import boundaries and structural contracts checked by scripts, wired into a PR workflow.

**Files:**
- Create: scripts/test-import-boundaries, scripts/test-foundry-script-strict, .github/workflows/pr-check.yml

**Verify:** task test:scripts -> exits 0; seeding a violation makes it exit 1

**Note:** the foundry.testlib suite is not in CI — it needs a Foundry engine binary with no published runner image. Deferred to the release plan; until then task test:foundrylib is a required local pre-merge step.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/test-import-boundaries", "scripts/test-foundry-script-strict", ".github/workflows/pr-check.yml"], "verifyCommand": "task test:scripts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["core-imports-subsystem rejected", "cross-subsystem import rejected", "internal import from non-internal rejected", "passes clean tree", "seeded violation exits 1"]}
```
